With MinerU configured (self-hosted, no signup / mineru.net cloud token): scanned PDFs become readable, formulas become click-citable (one click sends the LaTeX source into the chat) and searchable (QK^T hits directly), plus a per-page formula panel; optional embeddings endpoint adds semantic recall for plain-language questions. Rename/delete topics and papers — deletes go to a recoverable .trash with a batch-clear flow for non-empty topics; reader with scroll/single-page modes, rightbar-fullscreen safe, one-click path copy and translated-PDF export; in-place original ↔ Chinese toggle (babeldoc, zero preinstall). Transcription and search run locally by default — documents never leave your machine; only when cloud MinerU, an embeddings endpoint, or a translation endpoint is enabled does the corresponding text go to the service you configure.
description.zh-cn: 论文伴读工作台：文献库 + PDF 阅读器 + 教练式伴读。回答必带页码，点页码跳回 PDF 并高亮闪烁对应原文；选中即问不打断阅读；自带「严格师傅」preset——定阅读计划、逐节带读、出题批改，成绩跨会话累积；配置 MinerU（本地自建免注册 / mineru.net 云端 token 二选一）后：扫描版 PDF 可读可伴读、公式可点引用（点一下即得 LaTeX 源码进对话）、公式可检索（QK^T 直接命中），∑ 面板按页浏览全文公式；可选嵌入端点语义召回，大白话提问命中术语段落。文献库专题/论文改名删除——删除走 .trash 回收站可恢复、非空专题批量清空一次确认；阅读器滚动 ↔ 单页翻页双模式、右栏全屏可用、PDF 路径一键复制、译文 PDF 一键导出；原文 ↔ 纯中文原地切换（babeldoc 零预装）。默认本地转录检索，文档不出本机；仅当启用云端 MinerU、嵌入端点或翻译端点时，对应文本才会发往你配置的服务。

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a diff-preview confirmation panel.
description.zh-cn: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: Role-based LLM retry & fallback strategies.
description.zh-cn: 基于角色的模型重试与备用策略。

description.en: Manage archived and unarchived chats with search, previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, selected actions, global recycling, Recycle Bin recovery, storage and retention, origins and branches, and automatic residual chat checks.
description.zh-cn: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、选择操作、全局回收、回收站恢复、空间与保留策略、来源分支和自动残留会话检查。

description.en: Goal mode and autonomous execution plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sticky top banner keeps the current goal visible across turns while the agent works toward it autonomously.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的目标模式与自主执行插件：顶部吸附横幅在每轮对话中保持当前目标可见，同时 Agent 自主推进完成目标。

description.en: Manage VPS servers over SSH key login: 22 zero-token /vps- commands (status queries, recipe installs with a plan and /vps-yes confirmation, reboot that waits for the machine to come back), an in-conversation terminal (xterm.js over ssh -tt) for interactive programs, 5 agent tools with risk-tiered confirmation, file backup with automatic restore and a firewall/SSH safety net, 29 built-in recipes, and a settings page for adding machines.
description.zh-cn: 通过 SSH 密钥登录管理 VPS：22 条不走模型的 /vps- 命令（查看状态、按菜谱安装并先出计划再用 /vps-yes 确认、重启并等机器回来），对话里的终端（xterm.js + ssh -tt，可运行菜单脚本等交互程序），5 个按风险分级确认的 agent 工具，改文件自动备份与还原、改防火墙和 SSH 前设自动恢复，29 条内置菜谱，以及添加机器的设置页。

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh-cn: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: DSH right-sidebar plugin that compares two git commits, builds a manual-test checklist from the impact scope, and supports fail notes, screenshots, task attachments, and defect submission to Yunxiao, GitHub, GitLab, or a webhook.
description.zh-cn: DSH 右侧栏插件：对比两个 git 提交，根据影响面生成手测清单，支持失败备注、截图、任务附件，以及向云效 / GitHub / GitLab / Webhook 提交缺陷。

description.en: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutating tool execution, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot /rewind command that restores files and forks the session back to a checkpoint.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code /rewind 等价能力：每次变更型工具执行前捕获 git 优先的工作区文件快照，轮次边界 fork 会话，一条 /rewind 命令恢复文件并把会话回退到检查点。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed boot, whitelisted reversible fixes verified in an isolated instance first, an upgrade preview naming the plugins a target release would skip, and a panel with plugin-row management plus a RAG knowledge base of past failures.
description.zh-cn: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh-cn: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: Diagnoses and repairs DeepSeek Harness on native Windows around the official persistent PowerShell and Workspace Write stack, creates the desktop shortcut, and keeps earlier Git Bash and BusyBox presets behind an explicit legacy setup. No WSL.
description.zh-cn: 围绕官方持久 PowerShell 与 Workspace Write 方案检查和修复原生 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness，创建桌面快捷方式，并仅通过明确的 legacy 安装保留早期 Git Bash 与 BusyBox 预设，无需 WSL。

description.en: An agent preset for evidence-checked research: every step advances only through system-verified observations, L3+ claims go to an independent evaluator, and the session folds into a replayable ledger that grows into a browsable domain ontology. Requires DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1.
description.zh-cn: 以证据为准的研究用智能体预设：每一步只能靠系统核验过的观测推进，L3 以上的结论交给独立评估者，整场会话折成一份可重放的账本，并长成可浏览的领域本体。需要 DSH >=0.1.7-alpha.1。

description.en: Shell tool with four Windows backends (PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2) plus an interactive PTY terminal; the MSYS2 backend starts bash.exe with -lc so /etc/profile puts /usr/bin and /mingw64/bin on PATH, and injects MSYSTEM=MINGW64 into the PTY environment. Written in TypeScript, targets DSH 0.1.2+.
description.zh-cn: 一个 shell 工具：Windows 上支持 PowerShell / Git Bash / WSL / MSYS2 四种后端，外加交互式 PTY 终端；MSYS2 后端以 bash.exe -lc 启动，让 /etc/profile 把 /usr/bin 与 /mingw64/bin 带进 PATH，并为 PTY 环境注入 MSYSTEM=MINGW64。TypeScript 编写，面向 DSH 0.1.2+。

description.en: Per-model reasoning-effort and input-modality configuration for third-party providers: suggestions fused from a model knowledge base and raw /models endpoint evidence with confidence labels, edited inside the official Models page card.
description.zh-cn: 为第三方供应商模型按模型配置思考强度与输入模态：知识库与原始 /models 端点取证融合建议并标注置信度，在官方「模型」页卡片内直接编辑。

description.en: WSL tools for DSH: Linux commands with exit codes, timeouts and spill files; background jobs; path conversion; environment and project checks. Per task: a long-lived session for multi-step work, a fresh shell otherwise, subtasks above the composer. It also works in a terminal you opened, read-only while it runs, one click to take back the keyboard. Destructive commands need consent; root is a switch. Commands run as you, below the DSH sandbox.
description.zh-cn: DSH 的 WSL 工具：Linux 命令（退出码、超时、输出落盘）、后台作业、路径互转、环境与项目体检。终端按任务自动选择：多步任务用长期终端（一个会话贯穿，子任务记录显示在输入框上方），自洽命令用一次性终端（每次全新 shell、可并行）。也可在你新建的终端里协作：工作期间只读，点击「接管输入」即可收回键盘。危险命令需明确同意，root 是一个开关；命令以你的身份运行，位于 DSH 沙箱之下。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus an optional prompt-injection switch (off by default).
description.zh-cn: DSH 网页 UI 综合增强：中文补全、统计单行显示、思考自动展开、对话宽度、会话归档与删除，并可选的提示词注入（默认关闭）。

description.en: Four read-only tools over a WeKnora knowledge base: list knowledge bases, hybrid passage search, reassemble one document's chunks in order, and WeKnora's own cited RAG or ReAct-agent answer with a resumable session id.
description.zh-cn: 把 WeKnora 知识库接入 dsh 的四个只读工具：列出知识库、混合检索原文片段、按顺序还原单篇文档，以及直接取用 WeKnora 自己带引用的 RAG 或 ReAct agent 回答（含可续聊的 session id）。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh-cn: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Provides local and remote knowledge bases with project- and session-scoped recall, controlled write-back, and an embedded Web management console.
description.zh-cn: 提供本地与远程知识库，支持项目和会话范围检索、可控回写以及内嵌 Web 管理台。

description.en: A judgment core for DeepSeek Harness: a cognition loop that gives every decision a source and attribution and drives planning to a close, hippocampus memory that condenses running experience into knowledge (journal ledger, episodic archive, low-confidence decay), judgment identity responsibilities in the architecture (consistent rubric, judgment bound to its source), and an A2A memory-management team via dsh-linghun-assembler. Requires DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7 (rc.2 supported).
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的判断内核：认知循环让判断有来处、反馈有归因、规划收口；海马体把运行经历沉淀为可复用知识（序时账留痕、情景归档、低置信降权遗忘）；判分身份职责入架构（口径一致、判据绑定来源）；联动 dsh-linghun-assembler 的 A2A 记忆管理团队。需要 DSH ^0.1.0-rc.7（支持 rc.2）。

description.en: Verifiable research-report engine for DeepSeek Harness with a content-addressed evidence ledger, versioned sealed reports where every claim carries a verification verdict and the manifest hash seals the directory, and retrieval orchestration that reuses the ctx.web and ctx.jobs seams.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的可核查研究报告引擎：通过内容寻址的证据台账和版本化封存报告使每条结论携带核查结论，由 manifest 哈希封存目录，检索编排复用 ctx.web 与 ctx.jobs 接口。

description.en: Official-grade GitHub CI integration: a composite action.yml, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments and a status-check gate, plus PR/issues tools with every write gated by human approval.
description.zh-cn: 官方级 GitHub CI 集成：composite action.yml、轮询 PR 评审机器人（幂等行内评论 + status-check 门禁）以及 PR/issue 工具，所有写入走人工审批门。

description.en: Replaces the default web search and fetch channel with eight free search engines including Tavily, Exa and Brave, tried in a configurable fallback order. Keys are entered in a settings card that also toggles the web_fetch tool.
description.zh-cn: 把默认的 Web 搜索与抓取通道替换为 Tavily、Exa、Brave 等八个免费搜索引擎，按可配置的顺序依次 fallback。在设置卡片中填写各引擎 Key，并可开关 web_fetch 工具。

description.en: WorkBuddy-style skill picker: a button beside the composer opens a searchable list of installed skills; picking one inserts the official /skill-name gesture, so the skill loads with your message.
description.zh-cn: WorkBuddy 同款技能选择器：输入框旁 ⚡ 按钮弹出全部技能列表，支持搜索与最近/常用排序，点选即插入官方 `/技能名` 手势，随消息发出自动加载执行。

description.en: Bloom Morandi theme: ten variants (mist, cinnabar, petal, ripple, sage, stone, lapis, amber, aurora, lavender) built on OKLCH so light and dark stay perceptually even, switchable from the top bar, with all 20 foreground/background pairs measured at WCAG AA or better.
description.zh-cn: Bloom 莫兰迪主题：十款变体（黛蓝 mist、朱砂 cinnabar、桃夭 petal、天青 ripple、竹青 sage、赭石 stone、青金 lapis、琥珀 amber、落霞 aurora、青莲 lavender）基于 OKLCH 调色，明暗切换不跳变，顶栏一键切换，每套配色右侧标出处诗句，20 组「主色 + 底色」实测全部达到 WCAG AA。

description.en: Computer use for Windows: screenshot, mouse, keyboard, clipboard and window tools with per-app access that goes through DSH approval; while the agent is in control the screen shows an orange glow and a status bar, and Esc pauses or resumes.
description.zh-cn: Windows 电脑控制：截图、鼠标、键盘、剪贴板和窗口工具，按应用授权并经 DSH 审批；操控期间屏幕显示橙色光晕和提示条，按 Esc 暂停或继续。

description.en: Reads the session files thirty-three other coding agents on this machine already wrote — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, VS Code Copilot Chat, opencode, OpenClaw, Hermes, Kimi, Cline, Zed and more — including sessions from before it was installed: six tools (deja_recall, deja_session, deja_blame, deja_fix, deja_how, deja_remember), a /deja command, and optional automatic recall added to the runtime context. Local BM25 index, no LLM, no embeddings, no network (dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja).
description.zh-cn: 读取本机上其他三十三个编程智能体已经写下的会话文件——Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、VS Code Copilot Chat、opencode、OpenClaw、Hermes、Kimi、Cline、Zed 等，包括安装之前的历史：提供 deja_recall、deja_session、deja_blame、deja_fix、deja_how、deja_remember 六个工具与 /deja 命令，并可选地把召回结果加入运行时上下文。本地 BM25 索引，不用大模型，不用向量嵌入，不联网（dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deja）。

description.en: Smart checkpoints, workspace safety guards and instant rollback for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh-cn: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供智能检查点、工作区安全防护和即时回滚。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools, zero-cache-miss.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory: deterministic BM25 keyword recall (no embeddings), memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget tools behind a human-confirm gate, and global + project-scoped JSON stores that follow your git repo.
description.zh-cn: 跨会话明文记忆：确定性 BM25 关键词召回（无向量嵌入），memory_save/list/search/confirm/forget 五个工具 + 人工确认闸门，global/project 两层 JSON 存储（project 随 git 分享）。

description.en: Fills in what the official pi-ai adapter leaves out on the Models page: gateway reachability probing with latency, one-click pull of the gateway model catalog with checkbox write-back into settings, DeepSeek balance and provider quota shown in place, the protocol and endpoint each provider is actually wired to, and a model dropdown that lists only what works right now — a dead key, an empty balance or an exhausted quota is hidden until you fix it, and comes back on its own.
description.zh-cn: 补上官方 pi-ai 适配器在模型页缺的那半：网关可达性与延迟探测、一键拉取网关模型目录并勾选写回配置、DeepSeek 余额与各家配额就地常驻、每个 provider 实际接入的协议与地址；模型下拉只列当前真能用的分组 —— key 失效、余额耗尽、配额用尽都会被摘掉，修好后自动恢复。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh-cn: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Manages DSH skills and MCP servers from the web settings: skill cards with hot enable/disable, workspace scopes, groups, batch migration and drag-and-drop import, plus stdio/HTTP MCP CRUD with connection tests, secret redaction and the unified dsh-panel CLI.
description.zh-cn: 在 DSH Web 设置中管理技能与 MCP 服务器：技能卡片热启停、工作区作用域、分组、批量迁移与拖拽导入，以及 stdio/HTTP MCP 增删改查、连接测试、密钥脱敏，并附带统一 dsh-panel 命令行。

description.en: Keeps a pool of models and routes every agent step to one of them with its reasoning effort set — configured by clicking in the composer, no JSON needed. The router takes over the composer's model cell, so one control shows the session's model and reasoning effort alongside the router's own settings. Three authorization scopes (model / effort / full) where a manual pick only counts in the scope that owns it, and in effort scope the router is bound to the one model you choose. Task presets with per-model weights, vision routing for image steps, session signals (active todo, context pressure, token budget, subagent depth), and an optional semantic task classifier. Thinking stays on, because DeepSeek rejects a thinking-enabled request whose history contains a tool call made with thinking off.
description.zh-cn: 维护一个模型池，把每个 agent 步骤路由到池内模型并设置其思考等级——全部在输入栏点选配置，不需要写 JSON。路由面板接管输入栏的模型位置，同一个控件里既有本会话的模型与思考等级，也有路由自身的设置。三种授权范围（模型 / 思考 / 全部）：手动选择只在所属范围内生效；「思考」范围下路由只作用于你选定的那一个模型。另有按任务类型给模型加权的预设、带图任务的视觉分流、会话信号（当前 todo / 上下文压力 / token 预算 / 子 agent 深度），以及可选的语义任务分类。思考等级保持常开，因为 DeepSeek 会拒绝思考关闭时产生的工具调用。

description.en: Rewind conversation and workspace state, powered by a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh-cn: 对话回退：基于持久 Change Ledger 回滚会话与工作区状态。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use tools (click, type, key, screenshot) with freshness checks, approval gating, process-identity verification around every action, and a sanitized audit trail.
description.zh-cn: Windows 桌面电脑操作工具（点击、输入、按键、截屏）：每次动作都带新鲜度校验、审批门、进程身份核验与脱敏审计。

description.en: MCP server configuration card for the DSH Web GUI: add / edit / enable / disable MCP servers over stdio (local subprocess) or streamable-http (remote), with js: prefixed expressions for env / header values, status badges, and hot-reload on save.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的 MCP 服务器配置卡片：增删改查与启用/停用 MCP 服务器（stdio 本地子进程 / streamable-http 远程两种传输），env / headers 值支持 js: 前缀表达式，带状态徽标，保存即热生效。

description.en: IDE-style Git panel in the DSH Web GUI: a resident tab with a three-column overview (branch/tag list, searchable commit-history graph, commit detail with changed-file tree and message) and a changes page (stats bar, uncommitted list with per-file stage/unstage/discard, commit box with amend); side-by-side diffs carry lazy highlight.js syntax highlighting, on-demand between-hunk context expansion and word-level intra-line emphasis, with image files shown as before/after panes; plus a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar. Every git command runs as an argv array through the host subprocess service, cwd locked to the repo root.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 里的 IDE 风格 Git 面板：常驻标签页含三栏总览（分支/标签列表、可搜索的提交历史图、含变更文件树与提交信息的提交详情）与变更记录页（统计条、带逐文件暂存/取消/丢弃的未提交列表、含 amend 的提交框）；并排差异带懒加载 highlight.js 语法高亮、块间上下文按需展开与词级行内高亮，图片文件以变更前/后双图对照；另在输入框提供 zsh 风格分支标记。所有 git 命令以 argv 数组经宿主 subprocess 执行、cwd 锁定仓库根。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns Jev judgments into three automatic actions — pruning oversized tool output to the segments relevant to the request, screening fetched pages for instructions aimed at the model, and picking which skill fits the next step — plus the jev_ask and jev_gate tools, a judgment ledger that survives restarts, and a /jev-status report. Needs a TypeSafe API key; without one it is inert and sends nothing.
description.zh-cn: 把 Jev 判定变成三件自动动作的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：精简超长工具输出、筛查抓取页面里针对模型的指令、挑选下一步该用的 skill；另有 jev_ask 与 jev_gate 两个工具、可跨重启的判定账本，以及 /jev-status 报告。需要 TypeSafe API key，没有时完全惰性，不发任何请求。

description.en: Encrypted local credentials vault for the Harness: a web settings page and vault_* tools to store, search and copy passwords, API keys, TOTP secrets and card data, with health audits, expiry rotation, imports/exports and read-only/ask access modes.
description.zh-cn: Harness 的本地加密凭据保险库：Web 设置页与 vault_* 工具，可存取与复制密码、API 密钥、TOTP 与银行卡信息，支持健康审计、到期轮换、导入导出以及只读/询问访问模式。

description.en: Novel-writing workbench for DSH with an authoring preset, outline and character management, manuscript annotations, review workflows, and a managed local Python backend.
description.zh-cn: 面向 DSH 的小说创作工作台，提供创作预设、大纲与人物管理、正文批注、审稿流程和受管理的本地 Python 后端。

description.en: Reversible context slimming for DeepSeek Harness: TOON-style lossless tabular re-encoding of uniform JSON arrays, stride-sampled table windows with line numbers, and cross-turn dedup for repeated tool output; every replacement passes a byte-plus-token gate (≤72% bytes, strictly fewer estimated tokens) and the original is spilled to disk behind a `[save-token #id]` notice retrievable in one call via the `save_token_expand` tool, with billed and avoided token metering on a settings dashboard.
description.zh-cn: 可逆的上下文瘦身插件：均匀 JSON 数组走 TOON 式无损表格化重编码，管道表按行号抽样保留窗口，90 秒内字节级相同的工具输出跨轮去重；每次替换都要通过双重门（压缩后 ≤72% 字节且估算 token 严格下降），原文落盘并以 `[save-token #id]` 标记，可用 `save_token_expand` 工具一步取回；设置页仪表盘分别统计实际计费与节省的 token。

description.en: Mineradio glassmorphism theme for the DSH web UI: champagne-gold glass panes, a fluid or wallpaper backdrop, and a one-switch toggle that restores the stock look exactly.
description.zh-cn: Mineradio 玻璃拟态 DSH 网页主题：香槟金玻璃面板、流体或壁纸背景，一键开关即可还原原生界面。

description.en: Anime game banner and event schedule lookup: sidebar button with current banners, events, and countdowns for 11 gacha games, auto-refresh, and per-game selectable sources.
description.zh-cn: 二游卡池/活动排期速查：侧边栏按钮展示 11 款二游的当期卡池与活动起止（含倒计时），支持自动刷新与各游戏独立来源切换。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh-cn: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: Renders OpenTiny GenUI charts, forms, calculators and mini apps inline in DSH replies via schemaJson fences, with user actions flowing back into the conversation.
description.zh-cn: 通过 schemaJson 代码块在 DSH 回复内渲染 OpenTiny GenUI 图表、表单、计算器等迷你应用，用户操作自动回传对话。

description.en: LAN access for the official DSH Web UI through a gated reverse proxy: DSH keeps its own loopback binding, and a second port adds a password gate, self-signed HTTPS and per-device pairing that can be revoked individually, with a QR code to open it from a phone.
description.zh-cn: 把官方 DSH Web UI 安全地开放到局域网：不改动 DSH 自身的回环绑定，另开一个带密码门禁、自签 HTTPS 与可逐个吊销的设备配对的反向代理端口，并提供手机扫码入口。

description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh-cn: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.en: Twenty-one official HyperFrames by HeyGen skills synced from the official upstream (HTML video authoring, animation, keyframes, audio/music-to-video, CLI, registry, slideshow, talking-head recut, website/product/PR-to-video, Studio timeline conventions and more), plus a bundled-resource health check. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh-cn: 同步 HyperFrames by HeyGen 官方上游的二十一技能：HTML 写视频/动画/关键帧/音频与音乐转视频/CLI/注册表/幻灯片/口播重剪/网址·产品·PR 转视频/Studio 时间轴规范等，附随包资源完整性自检。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch — all as pure cordis plugins with zero upstream patches.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Code-graph integration for the DSH Web GUI: a "Codegraph" card in Settings → Plugins with index status, symbol search, callers / callees / impact views, and one-click sync / index; hosts the codegraph MCP server and injects a CodeGraph usage guideline into the system prompt. Requires the codegraph CLI.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的 Codegraph 集成：设置 → 插件 中的「Codegraph」卡片提供索引状态、符号搜索、callers/callees/impact 查看与一键 sync/index；托管 codegraph MCP 服务器，并向 system prompt 注入 Codegraph 使用指引。需安装 codegraph CLI。

description.en: Adds an x_search tool for X/Twitter search to DeepSeek Harness, authenticated through a separate SuperGrok OAuth account so it does not consume the session provider quota.
description.zh-cn: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加用于 X/Twitter 搜索的 x_search 工具，通过独立的 SuperGrok OAuth 账号鉴权，不占用会话所用提供方的配额。

description.en: Gitea and Forgejo integration for DeepSeek Harness with issue, pull-request and worktree tools plus a Git status chip.
description.zh-cn: 为 DeepSeek Harness 集成 Gitea 与 Forgejo，提供 issue、拉取请求和 worktree 工具及 Git 状态芯片。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into a server-grade multi-tenant platform: remote access + auto HTTPS, subuser permissions & token/daily quotas, sandbox enforcement, encrypted auth & audit log.
description.zh-cn: 让 DeepSeek Harness 变成服务器级多租户平台：远程访问 + 自动 HTTPS、子用户权限与配额、沙盒强制、加密认证与审计日志。

description.en: Motor-design AI assistant plugin: requirement parsing → parameter identification → candidate matrix → Top10 verification. L0 is a millisecond-level broad filter (pure JS, zero solver dependency) that ranks candidates and emits the handoff payload for the L1/L2 precision tools; usable as a local agent preset and Cordis plugin. L1 (RMxprt) and L2 (Motor-CAD) are reserved in this version — the level gate fails fast above l0.
description.zh-cn: 电机 AI 辅助设计插件：需求解析 → 参数识别 → 候选矩阵 → Top10 校验。L0 纯 JS、零求解器依赖，毫秒级广筛候选并给出交给 L1/L2 精算工具的载荷；可作为本地 agent 预设与 Cordis 插件使用。L1（RMxprt）与 L2（Motor-CAD）在本版本中仅预留接口，层级总闸设为 l0 以上会立即报错。

description.en: Install tab in Settings → Plugins: install, update and remove any plugin by npm spec, `github:user/repo` or local path through the same `dsh plugin add` CLI path; update checks against npm latest or GitHub HEAD with a downgrade guard and resolved-version verification, a pnpm 11 release-cooldown bypass on every add/remove, and service restart via the DSH Desktop shell or a relay process under standalone `dsh web`.
description.zh-cn: 设置 → 插件里的「安装」标签页：按 npm spec、`github:user/repo` 或本地路径安装、更新、卸载任意插件，走的都是 `dsh plugin add` 这条 CLI 路径；更新检查对照 npm latest 或 GitHub HEAD，带降级保护与装后版本核对，每次 add/remove 均附带 pnpm 11 发布冷静期豁免；服务重启在 DSH Desktop 由壳层执行，独立 `dsh web` 下由中转进程接力并交接回原终端。

description.en: Personal coding assistant that schedules, follows up on and verifies local Codex or Claude Code tasks from DSH, with WeChat, WeCom and Feishu remote channels.
description.zh-cn: 个人编码助理：在 DSH 中安排、跟进与验收本机 Codex 或 Claude Code 任务，并提供微信、企业微信与飞书远程渠道。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: SSH ops terminal for DSH Web UI: drive a connected server from the main conversation (ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect) while keeping an interactive xterm.js terminal on the right.
description.zh-cn: DSH SSH 运维终端：在主对话中直接指挥已连接的服务器（ssh_connect/ssh_exec/ssh_read/ssh_write/ssh_disconnect），右侧保留可交互的 xterm.js 终端。

description.en: Telegram bridge for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional sessions, conversation steering, home-channel routing, and TTS voice notes sent as Telegram audio messages.

description.en: Puts the Markdown documents, source files, images and video that already exist anywhere in the session workspace into the DSH sidebar, ranked by relevance to the current conversation. The default lexical mode matches your recent messages against title, summary and body locally with IDF weighting (BM25) — no model calls, no network, nothing leaves the machine. The list comes from scanning the workspace rather than from a recent-files list, so restarting DSH or opening a new session does not empty it. Results are organised into a three-tier reading order (primary / supporting / related) with a verifiable reason on every row — which field matched, which document cites this one — and one click opens an in-place preview: Markdown as rendered text, relative-path images actually drawn, source code with the host's own syntax highlighting, video streamed over HTTP Range. The same Context Pack is exposed to the agent as a knit_docs tool. Later versions added read evidence and lifecycle tracking (attribution is frozen at the moment of reading), pin / exclude (exclusion applies before retrieval, and is undoable), relation evidence (references / imports / tests, with line numbers) and an incremental index reused across restarts. Since v0.23 there is also an optional hybrid mode: it is off by default and only runs once you configure an Ollama or OpenAI-compatible embedding provider yourself. When it runs, what leaves the machine is your query text plus each candidate file's title and summary — a Markdown summary is an excerpt of the body's first paragraph (at most 60 characters), a code file's summary is its workspace-relative directory, and an image or video contributes its file name; full bodies and absolute paths are not sent, and a loopback provider keeps everything on this machine. Since v0.24 it also associates uncommitted changes: a read-only git status (fixed argv, no shell, whitelisted child-process environment) combined with the same reference / import / test / mention evidence shows which files a change is likely to drag along, and it is off by default. The benefit of semantic retrieval still awaits a real-provider run, so no recall improvement is claimed.
description.zh-cn: 把会话工作区里已有的 Markdown 文档、源码、图片与视频列进 DSH 侧边栏，按与当前对话的相关性排序。默认的词法模式用最近几条消息在本地与标题、摘要、正文做带 IDF 加权的匹配（BM25）—— 不调用模型、没有网络出口，内容不出本机。列表来自工作区扫描，而不是「最近打开记录」，所以重启 DSH 或新开会话都不会变空。排序结果组织成主要 / 辅助 / 相关三层的阅读顺序，每一条都写明可核验的理由（命中了哪个字段、被哪一篇引用），点一行即可就地预览：Markdown 按渲染后的样子显示、相对路径图片真实渲染、源码走宿主自带的语法高亮、视频走 HTTP Range 流式播放。同一份 Context Pack 也作为 knit_docs 工具交给 agent。后续版本陆续补上读取证据与生命周期（归因在读那一刻冻结）、固定 / 排除（排除先于检索生效，且可恢复）、关系证据（引用 / 导入 / 测试，带行号）与增量索引（重启后复用）。v0.23 起还多一条可选的混合检索：默认关闭，只有你自己配好 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容的 embedding 服务才会生效。它生效时，发出去的是你这句查询原话加上每篇候选文件的标题与摘要 —— Markdown 的摘要取自正文首段（不超过 60 字），代码的摘要是它所在的工作区相对目录，图片 / 视频贡献的是文件名；完整正文与绝对路径都不发送，指向本机服务（loopback）时内容不出这台机器。v0.24 起还能做变更关联：用一条只读的 git status（固定 argv、不走 shell、子进程环境白名单），配合同一套引用 / 导入 / 测试 / 提及证据，指出这次改动大概率该一起看哪些文件 —— 默认关闭。语义检索的收益仍待真 provider 实测，因此不承诺召回提升。

description.en: Long-term cross-session markdown memory with an LLM-Wiki structure and a SOUL.md persona, injected at session start (by default only after the first user message and only in the active session), plus remember/recall/consolidate/forget workflows, an embedded memory skill, pack/unpack migration tooling, and an idle-time first-person recall nudge that surfaces real memories in a companion voice. Also gives the store observability and upkeep it lacked: a per-file boot-block budget that keeps the index routing table from being truncated, automatic last_access stamping so salience decay actually works, a read-only memory health dashboard (size, freshness, lint-parity checks), a declarative index compiler (pages declare summary:, one command re-lines the index), an interactive memory graph (page links plus shared tags, draggable, wheel zoom), structured queries (tag/type/salience/hot/stale filters), cross-link suggestions for pages that have no relationship yet, and a `checkup` report that ends in a prioritised action list. The boot payload was also cut by ~23% by moving operational detail into the on-demand skill. Its settings section now carries its own navigation mark (a brain half wired to a node cluster, since the shell offers no icon slot to plugins) and a feedback entry that opens this repository. Requires DSH session format v4 (official DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7+): injected messages declare the producer-owned source kind plugin:memory.

description.en: One-command backup, restore & migration for all DSH user data (~/.dsh) with a visual Settings panel: scheduled auto-backup with tiered retention, sha256 verification, hardened restore with auto-rollback and a result receipt, typed sub-backups (--types), credential redaction into a local vault, private-repo GitHub sync for moving to a new machine, and an out-of-process rescue console (zero-dependency rescue web UI in the backup dir) that works even when the host won't boot. /backup doctor checks and repairs corrupt session logs from a known-good backup and quarantines them before rotation; migrate-check statically predicts which sessions a host upgrade would break (frozen event-list rules, filename/generation mismatch, hardlink support, legacy credentials); the credential sentinel preserves pre-migration copies before the host rewrites them; smart backup snapshots before host upgrades; /backup check-update and /backup update report and install new releases (snapshotting first). Restore handles attachment hard links and arbitrarily large archives (streamed listing). Current npm version 0.13.4; spans DSH 0.1.1-rc.2 through 0.2.0-rc.1, including 0.2.0's install-time peer gate. macOS/Linux/Windows.

description.en: Renders assistant replies with numbered citation chips and a sources panel for web-search results, inline pictures with their source captions, and KaTeX formulas, Mermaid diagrams and highlighted code in streaming Markdown.
description.zh-cn: 为助手回答渲染带编号的引用角标和来源面板（针对联网搜索结果）、带来源说明的正文配图，并在流式 Markdown 中渲染 KaTeX 公式、Mermaid 图和代码高亮。

description.en: Live-tune the DSH Web conversation UI from Settings: message font size, Claude Desktop-style markdown tables, dialog width, an optional timeline rail, and a GitBar with branch management, per-file diff, and commit & push.
description.zh-cn: 从设置面板实时调教 DSH 网页对话界面：消息字体大小、Claude Desktop 风格 Markdown 表格、对话框宽度、可选时间线侧栏，以及带分支管理、逐文件 Diff 和提交推送功能的 GitBar。

description.en: DeepSeek-styled cross-session token usage, request count, and tiered cost analytics dashboard.
description.zh-cn: 仿 DeepSeek 官方 Token 统计，跨会话 Token 消耗、请求次数与峰谷分时费用统计看板。

description.en: Voice I/O for DeepSeek Harness — speech-to-text and text-to-speech over the microphone and audio output.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入输出：麦克风语音转文字与文字转语音。

description.en: MCP server manager (stdio / streamable-http): per-working-directory project and global config tiers; project-level MCP collapsed into 4 atomic tools through a middleware layer by default (`middleware: all` folds in global servers too, hot-switchable in the settings page); workspace isolation prevents cross-project interference; configs keep `${ENV}` references only, with no plaintext secrets on disk; runtime registration API for other plugins to inject MCP servers.
description.zh-cn: MCP 服务器管理器（stdio / streamable-http）：按工作目录分项目级/全局两级配置；项目级 MCP 默认经中间层收敛为 4 个原子工具（`middleware: all` 连同全局服务器一并收敛，设置页热切换）；工作空间隔离防串台；配置只存 `${ENV}` 引用、不落盘明文密钥；提供运行时注册接口供其他插件注入 MCP。

description.en: Multi-platform API balance and usage dashboard for the DSH web GUI: balances for DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Kimi, StepFun, SiliconFlow, MiniMax, OpenRouter, Novita and xAI under the composer, estimated per-session and per-subagent cost with DeepSeek peak/off-peak pricing, automatic discovery of relays configured in DSH settings, and an optional draggable whale widget.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的多平台 API 余额与用量看板：在输入框下方显示 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、Kimi、阶跃星辰、硅基流动、MiniMax、OpenRouter、Novita、xAI 的余额，估算本会话与子代理消耗并按 DeepSeek 峰谷计价，自动发现 DSH 设置里已配置的中转站，另有一个可拖拽的大肥鱼挂件。

description.en: Honest merge of two community plugins into one calmer display: the streaming reading view from dsh-better-display (fork) and the message rail from dsh-tidychat. For theme lovers it wraps reasoning prose and tool-call output in translucent message bubbles, so text no longer sits directly on busy wallpapers or skins where it is hard to read. Cross-version rc adaptation attempted across DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 (all rc); no obvious problems so far.
description.zh-cn: 诚实说明：将两个社区插件合并为一个更安静的显示层——流式阅读视图来自 dsh-better-display（fork），消息轨道来自 dsh-tidychat。为主题爱好者把思考正文与工具调用输出包裹进半透明消息泡泡框，避免文字直接铺在复杂壁纸或皮肤上难以分辨。已在 DSH 0.1.0-0.2.0 各 rc 版本间尝试跨版本适配，目前无明显问题。

description.en: AI4Scholar academic search: 38 tools over Semantic Scholar, PubMed, Google Scholar, arXiv, bioRxiv/medRxiv, and DOI resolution (search, citation graph, authors, recommendations, PDF full text in slices, auto-cite, scientific figures), a unified cross-platform search with de-duplication, an API-key card in Settings, and per-call credit accounting with an `/ai4scholar` balance card.
description.zh-cn: AI4Scholar 学术检索：覆盖 Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv、bioRxiv/medRxiv 与 DOI 解析的 38 个工具（搜索、引用图谱、作者、推荐、PDF 全文分片、自动引用、科研绘图），跨平台去重统一搜索，设置页 API Key 卡片，按次积分统计与 `/ai4scholar` 余额卡。

description.en: Ollama provider for DeepSeek Harness with model management, health checks, rule-based local routing, and cloud fallback.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的 Ollama 接入：模型管理、健康检查、基于规则的本地路由与云端回退。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh-cn: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: Heartbeat loop for DeepSeek Harness: every 20 minutes (by default) the agent wakes on its own to keep a local profile of your interests and preferences, search the web for things you care about, and keep what it finds. When it has something worth sharing, it sends a short package of notes to the sessions you link it to. A set of rules in code - quiet hours, busy windows, a daily limit, a cooldown - decides whether it may speak at all, and the agent in that session decides whether to actually say anything. Windows only.
description.zh-cn: 心跳循环：默认每 20 分钟自己醒一次——维护一份关于你兴趣与偏好的本地画像，按你设的兴趣范围上网搜新东西并存下来。攒到值得分享的内容，就向你绑定的会话送一份简短的素材包。能不能开口由代码里的规则决定（静默时段、忙时窗口、每日上限、冷却），说不说由那个会话里的 agent 自己判断。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Select text in the DSH web UI to stream a translation and an explanation of what it means in that specific context, read against the conversation it came from; the panel keeps a replayable history and can be promoted into a full session.
description.zh-cn: 在 DSH Web 界面划词，小窗流式给出翻译，并结合这段文字所在的会话上下文解释它在这里的具体含义；面板带可回放的历史记录，也能一键升格为正式会话。

description.en: Font plugin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: the conversation gets its own font, size, line height and weight, the interface has a font and a weight of its own and follows the conversation by default, code keeps its own axis with ligature control, and whole setups save as presets.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 字体插件：对话拥有字体、字号、行高与字重，界面用字体与字重并默认跟随对话（也可独立设置，两边互不影响），代码独立成轴并支持连字，整套配置可存为预设方案。

description.en: Risk-gated approval automation for DeepSeek Harness: flash pre-classifies whether a write/command is irreversible — safe operations are auto-approved, dangerous ones are escalated to human approval (fail-safe). File-diff review with one-click revert and session-scoped snapshots (v0.5.1: precise snapshots via tool-call parameter tracing, incl. human-approval cases).
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 自动审批门控：Flash 预判写入/命令是否不可回补，安全操作自动批准、危险操作转人工（fail-safe）。另含文件改动对比（unified diff）与一键撤销、按会话隔离的快照管理（v0.5.1：通过工具调用参数回溯精确保存快照，覆盖人工审批场景）。

description.en: Aggregated web search provider that fans one query out to 11 engines (Exa, Parallel, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, Brave, Tavily, Serper, Mojeek, DeepSeek, Anthropic, OpenAI) concurrently, URL-dedupes and merges the results. Ships a settings card for toggling backends, storing API keys in the credential store, and tuning concurrency and timeouts.
description.zh-cn: 聚合网络搜索插件：一次查询并发分发到 11 个引擎（Exa、Parallel、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Brave、Tavily、Serper、Mojeek、DeepSeek、Anthropic、OpenAI），URL 去重后合并结果。设置面板卡片可开关后端、将 API Key 存入凭证库，并调整并发与超时。

description.en: Image and video wallpapers for the DSH web workspace: auto-detected GIF/APNG/animated WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM backgrounds with blur, brightness and dimming, tint-following UI, per-component transparency, and one-click preset wallpapers.
description.zh-cn: 为 DSH 提供图片/视频壁纸背景：GIF/APNG/动图 WebP/PNG/JPEG/MP4/WebM 魔数自动识别，压暗/亮度/高斯模糊，界面色调与字体颜色自动跟随背景，各组件独立透明度，预置壁纸一键应用。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory, natively: typed memory files (user/feedback/project/reference) with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt (zero footprint when empty); memory_write/read/list/delete follow Claude Code write rules (dedupe-and-update, absolute dates, cross-links); workspace-scoped and user-scoped layers, cross-process file locking with orphan-lock recovery, plain Markdown on disk, no external services, no embeddings.
description.zh-cn: 原生实现 Claude Code 式自动记忆:类型化记忆文件(user/feedback/project/reference)+ 自动注入系统提示词的 MEMORY.md 索引,无记忆时零提示词占用;memory_write/read/list/delete 遵循 Claude Code 写入规则(查重更新、相对日期转绝对、交叉链接);项目级与用户级双层作用域,跨进程文件锁与孤儿锁自愈,记忆为磁盘纯 Markdown,无外部服务、无 embedding。

description.en: LLM-assisted auto approval with countdown fallback for the Auto permission preset: static rules, risk tiers, breaker and file audit.
description.zh-cn: 为 DSH Auto 权限档提供 LLM 辅助自动审批：静态规则、LLM 复审、风险分档、人工倒计时兜底、熔断与文件级审计。

description.en: Agent preset for DeepSeek Harness that layers the self-referential Cordis toolset (dynamic plugins, runtime inspection) and preset-authoring skills onto the PTC Code-Mode preset; materialized files carry per-file sha256 markers, so user-edited presets are never overwritten on upgrade or uninstall.
description.zh-cn: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的 Agent 预设：在 PTC 编码模式之上叠加自引用 Cordis 工具集（动态插件、运行时检视）与预设编写技能；物化文件带逐文件 sha256 标记，用户改过的预设升级与卸载时都不会被覆盖。

description.en: Runs Claude Code as a DSH conversation while preserving its native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
description.zh-cn: 将 Claude Code 作为 DSH 会话运行，同时保留其原生智能体循环、工具、技能、钩子和 MCP 集成。

description.en: Talk about everything in one chat (the main chat): each message is routed automatically to the topic it belongs to, each topic runs in its own background session with its own context, and existing DSH chat history is organized into topics.
description.zh-cn: 所有事在一个对话框（主聊天）里聊：每条消息自动分到所属话题，每个话题在后台有独立的会话和上下文；已有的 DSH 旧会话也会自动整理、分类成话题。

description.en: Local-only project memory with zero bundled runtime dependencies or external services: JSON as the source of truth plus generated PROJECT_MEMORY.md, token-bounded session-frozen Hot Memory for prompt-prefix cache stability, cached cross-project BM25 recall, trusted session/turn provenance, explainable pre-write duplicate/conflict governance, editable importance/pin/tags/supersede/archive lifecycle, configurable top-level turn-end distillation, and a bilingual Web GUI for search, inspection, diagnostics, and live settings.
description.zh-cn: 仅本地运行、零捆绑运行时依赖（仅使用 DSH 宿主 peer）且不调用外部服务的项目记忆：以 JSON 为单一事实源并自动生成 PROJECT_MEMORY.md、按 token 有界且按会话冻结的 Hot Memory 以保持 prompt-prefix cache 稳定、带查询缓存的跨项目 BM25 召回、可信 session/turn 溯源、可解释的写前重复/冲突治理、可编辑的重要度/置顶/标签/supersede/归档生命周期、可配置的顶层回合自动蒸馏，以及支持搜索、检查、诊断和实时设置的中英双语 Web GUI。

description.en: Renders HTML, React (JSX/TSX), Vue, SVG, Mermaid and Markdown written by the agent in an isolated iframe sandbox with SSE hot-reload, and adds a DOM click inspector, side-by-side visual diff, a responsive device matrix and one-click Vite ZIP export.
description.zh-cn: 在隔离的 iframe 沙箱中实时渲染 Agent 生成的 HTML、React (JSX/TSX)、Vue、SVG、Mermaid 和 Markdown，支持 SSE 热重载，并提供 DOM 点击检查器、并排视觉对比、响应式设备矩阵和一键 Vite ZIP 导出。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh-cn: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats into DeepSeek Harness as an in-process plugin over Tencent's iLink bot protocol, with two-way text, image, file and voice messaging, in-WeChat slash commands resolved through the native command registry, WeChat-side handling of approvals and agent questions, and proactive push through a send_wechat tool.
description.zh-cn: 以进程内 Cordis 插件的形式，通过腾讯 iLink bot 协议把微信私聊桥接到 DeepSeek Harness——双向收发文本、图片、文件与语音，微信内 slash 命令经原生命令注册中心解析（DSH 新增命令零改动可用），支持在微信端处理审批与提问，并提供 send_wechat 工具主动推送。

description.en: Full-text global search for the DSH Web GUI: a sidebar search box that searches history sessions (via the sessionQuery index, with a per-session scan fallback) and settings panels, highlights matches, and jumps to the matching session or settings card.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的全局搜索插件：侧边栏全局搜索框全文搜索历史会话（走 sessionQuery 全文索引，未启用时降级为逐会话扫描）与设置面板，关键词高亮，点击直达会话或对应设置卡片。

description.en: Views and builds CAD models (STL, OBJ, STEP, IGES, DXF, SVG) via cad_view/cad_info and OCCT parametric modeling tools, with an interactive viewer card and a resident CAD panel in the Web UI.
description.zh-cn: 通过 cad_view/cad_info 与 OCCT 参数化建模工具查看和构建 CAD 模型（STL、OBJ、STEP、IGES、DXF、SVG），并在 Web UI 中提供交互式查看卡片与常驻 CAD 面板。

description.en: Multi-engine text-to-image generation (OpenAI Images and Zhipu CogView presets) with per-session quota tracking, engine failover, credential-safe config, and a result card with regenerate.
description.zh-cn: 多引擎文生图（OpenAI Images 与智谱 CogView 预设）：按会话配额、引擎故障切换、凭证安全配置，结果卡片支持重新生成。

description.en: Multi-threaded downloader plugin for DeepSeek Harness with bundled aria2: probes the target for Range support, then picks aria2 (4 or 8 connections by file size) or falls back to curl.
description.zh-cn: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2：先探测目标是否支持 Range，再按文件大小选择 aria2（4 或 8 连接）或回退 curl 单线程下载。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that statically parses Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` files into structured pages in the DSH right sidebar (the source is never executed: no eval, no bundler, no sandbox iframe), with a file-viewer takeover for `.tsx` and a bundled Skill for authoring the format.
description.zh-cn: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把 Qoder Canvas `*.canvas.tsx` 静态解析为结构化页面渲染在右侧栏（不执行源码，无 eval / bundler / 沙箱 iframe），并附带 `.tsx` 文件查看器接管与一个教 LLM 写该格式的 Skill。

description.en: Automatic model-tier routing for DeepSeek Harness: one user instruction enters, one tier decision comes out — complex intent is planned on the strong tier and implemented on the cheap tier, simple intent stays cheap throughout, with a deterministic guard and a TTL escalation fallback.
description.zh-cn: 自动模型档位路由：一条用户指令进入、一个档位决策出来——复杂意图由强档规划、廉价档执行，简单意图全程廉价档，确定性护栏 + TTL 升级回退。

description.en: Arrow-key navigation for the DSH Web GUI: Up/Down switch sessions inside the current workspace and Left/Right switch workspaces, reading session identity from the client controllers rather than the DOM, and yielding the keys back to the composer while a draft is being edited.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的方向键导航：上/下在当前工作区内切换会话，左/右切换工作区；会话身份来自客户端控制器而非 DOM；输入框存在草稿时把方向键交还给光标。

description.en: Human-readable Markdown memory for DeepSeek Harness: user-level (~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md) + workspace-level memory injected every turn, auto daily-log writing with distillation, bridges existing WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy memory dirs, memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read tools with built-in dedup, and a bilingual settings page. Plain-text storage, no database.
description.zh-cn: 人类可读的 Markdown 记忆插件：用户级（~/.deepseek-harness/MEMORY.md）+ 工作区级双层记忆，每轮自动注入提示词，回合结束自动写日志并按期蒸馏沉淀；可桥接已有 WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy 记忆目录；内置 memory_note / memory_note_user / memory_read 三个工具（自动去重）与中英双语设置页。纯文件存储、无数据库，记事本即可编辑。

description.en: Cross-platform Computer Use for DeepSeek Harness: virtual-mouse human-like operation (screen_observe + computer_click + type + key + scroll + drag, 11 tools), AX-tree zero-vision-cost mode with free GLM-4V-Flash vision fallback, safety guards (snapshot TTL / app whitelist / dangerous-action approval / password-box protection).
description.zh-cn: 跨平台 Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作（screen_observe / computer_click / type / key / scroll / drag 共 11 个工具），AX 语义树零视觉成本 + GLM-4V-Flash 免费视觉兜底，安全护栏（快照 TTL / 应用白名单 / 危险操作审批 / 密码框保护）。

description.en: An AI routing gateway that runs as a DSH plugin. Adds a Routing System sidebar panel for suppliers, account pool, fallback combos and API keys, and serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at http://localhost:3080/v1.
description.zh-cn: 以 DSH 插件形式运行的 AI 路由网关。侧边栏新增「路由系统」面板管理供应商、账号池、回退组合与 API 密钥，并在 http://localhost:3080/v1 提供 OpenAI 兼容端点。

description.en: Whale girl desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: browser floating mascot plus Windows desktop pet sharing one data backend, with real-time balance board, task notices, head-pat interaction, 19 pre-synthesized voiced lines with per-line emotion, and presence-aware idle speech.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌宠：浏览器悬浮桌宠与 Windows 桌面桌宠共享一套数据，实时余额木牌、任务通知、摸头互动、19 句预合成带情感的台词朗读，空闲节奏随是否在场自适应。

description.en: A persona and memory plugin for DSH Desktop. Distill characters from chats, novels, scripts, or character sheets; keep long-term and temporary memories, learn style corrections and approved replies, detect persona leakage after switching, visualize memories, and import or export persona cards. Task guidance is reduced to one lightweight fixed discipline with no plans, ledgers, or dynamic reminders.
description.zh-cn: DSH Desktop 人设与记忆插件：从聊天记录、小说、剧本或设定文档蒸馏角色；支持长期与临时记忆、风格学习、认可语料、人设切换纠偏、记忆星图和角色卡导入导出。任务侧仅保留轻量工作纪律，不再注入计划、台账或动态提醒。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh-cn: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: Terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness on jump hosts and high-latency links: plain ANSI, incremental repaint, and a session that survives a dropped SSH connection (resume it from the log).
description.zh-cn: 跳板机与高延迟 SSH 上的 DeepSeek Harness 终端：纯 ANSI、增量重绘；SSH 掉线后会话不丢，可用 --resume 接回。

description.en: Provider-independent DSH document parsing powered by MinerU, with native background jobs, immutable results, and safe request coalescing.
description.zh-cn: 基于 MinerU 的统一文档解析，支持自托管与官方云双 Provider、DSH 原生后台任务、不可变产物缓存与请求合并。

description.en: Connect Google Antigravity Code Assist OAuth accounts to DeepSeek Harness for Gemini and Claude streaming LLM routing and Nano Banana 2 image generation.
description.zh-cn: 接入 Google Antigravity Code Assist OAuth 账号，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Gemini 与 Claude 流式模型路由及 Nano Banana 2 图像生成。

description.en: Local Markdown notes as governable working memory for DeepSeek Harness agents: dual-mode source/WYSIWYG editor with images, convention or reference notes auto-inject into the system prompt with sensitive values masked, plus snapshot version history, recycle bin, undoable archiving, AI reorganization, backlinks and full-text search. Compatible with DSH 0.1.7-0.2.x.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的可治理 Agent 工作记忆层，沉淀为本地 Markdown 笔记：双模式编辑器（源码⇄富文本，支持图片），约定/资料笔记自动注入系统提示（敏感值自动脱敏），另有快照版本历史、回收站、可撤销归档、AI 整理、双链与全文搜索。兼容 DSH 0.1.7～0.2.x。

description.en: Remote development launcher for DeepSeek Harness: provisions dsh on a remote host via SSH (or a local WSL distro) and connects from the local client, with LLM credentials proxied through a reverse tunnel so they never leave the local machine. Ships as both a standalone CLI and a dsh plugin with a session panel, /remote-explorer slash command and remote_* agent tools.
description.zh-cn: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Read-only DeepSeek Harness Web sidebar version chip that shows the running DSH version, npm latest/next/alpha channels, compatibility labels, and a copy-only upgrade command.
description.zh-cn: 只读的 DeepSeek Harness Web 侧栏版本芯片，显示当前运行版本、npm latest/next/alpha 通道、兼容性标识，以及仅复制的升级命令。

description.en: Exports the session event stream to OpenTelemetry OTLP and Langfuse as sanitized, buffered traces and metrics, off by default.
description.zh-cn: 将会话事件流导出为 OpenTelemetry OTLP 与 Langfuse 的脱敏、缓冲 traces 与指标，默认关闭。

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one "今日值得读" Markdown digest each day and injected into the system prompt; Web GUI settings card and sidebar reader.
description.zh-cn: DSH 的 RSS/新闻聚合插件：内置渠道库 + awesome-rsshub-routes 精选订阅源目录 + 自定义源（保存时真实抓取校验），每天自动汇总成「今日值得读」Markdown 并注入 systemPrompt；带 Web 设置卡片与侧边栏阅读弹窗。

description.en: Turn a phone camera into a live viewfinder and photo input for your dsh session, over LAN or USB.
description.zh-cn: 把手机相机变成 dsh 会话的实时取景与拍照输入，经局域网或 USB 直连。

description.en: Custom background image for the DSH Web UI: upload a picture or paste an image URL behind the whole app surface, with opacity, theme-aware scrim, panel transparency, frosted-glass and wallpaper blur, live preview and persisted settings, plus an optional DeepSeek-style timeline rail with per-question bookmarks for long conversations.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web 自定义背景插件：上传本地图片或粘贴图片链接作为全界面背景，可调不透明度、明暗自适应遮罩、面板透明度、毛玻璃与壁纸模糊，实时预览、设置持久化；另附可选的 DeepSeek 官网风格会话时间线导航轨，支持重点书签与快速跳转。

description.en: Calendar and hierarchical task workbench: AI-assisted intake clarification, consultation, decomposition, execution with user acceptance, and review, plus reminders and per-task AI session workspaces.
description.zh-cn: 日历 + 层级任务个人工作台：AI 辅助澄清、咨询、拆解、执行（用户验收）与复盘，支持到期提醒与按任务组织的 AI 会话工作区。

description.en: Inline-edit and recall your own user messages in dsh web — lazily and seamlessly, with a version pager and per-session draft persistence.
description.zh-cn: 在 dsh web 中内联编辑与撤回自己的消息——惰性、无痕，带版本翻页器与会话级草稿持久化。

description.en: DSH notification & remote-control plane: one `notify()` API across 28 outbound channels, six inbound control channels, phone approvals/questions/task control, a Native DSH Notify & Control UI, live outbound hot-apply, multi-agent routing, and zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh-cn: DSH 通知与远程操作控制面：一个 `notify()` API 接入 28 个出站渠道，六条入站控制通道承载手机审批、提问与任务控制；提供 DSH 原生「通知与控制」UI、出站热生效、多 agent 路由，并保持零运行时依赖。

description.en: Registers any set of HTTP APIs as paired doc-query and request tools for the agent.
description.zh-cn: 把任意一套 HTTP 接口注册成 agent 可用的文档查询与请求双工具。

description.en: A balance and cost widget for the DSH web GUI: a sidebar footer card shows the account balance, a remaining-ratio bar and today costs; clicking opens a four-tier cost breakdown (last prompt / this session / today-this-project / today-all) with term explanations and a one-click top-up link. Zero external dependencies, works on Node 24.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的余额与成本小部件：侧边栏底部卡片显示账户余额、剩余比例条与今日花费；点击展开四层级成本明细（最近提问 / 本会话 / 今日·本项目 / 今日·全部），带名词解释与一键充值入口。零依赖，兼容 Node 24。

description.en: Deterministic research reports for Chinese public mutual funds built from public-source data (Tiantian Fund and Eastmoney), pure-function metrics (performance decomposition, holdings penetration, style attribution, manager profile), and versioned reports with a per-number snapshot traceability appendix.
description.zh-cn: 中国公募基金确定性研究报告：采集天天基金/东方财富公开数据，纯函数计算业绩拆解、持仓穿透、风格归因与经理画像，输出带逐数字可溯源快照附录的版本化报告。

description.en: Role-based multi-agent team for DeepSeek Harness — your digital workforce. One goal assembles a team of product, architect, frontend, backend, reviewer and QA roles that deliver through a nine-phase gated pipeline, plus a persistent team you can keep directing across sessions. Zero runtime dependencies, no build step.
description.zh-cn: 角色化多智能体专家团 = 你的数字员工。一句目标即自动组建最多 12 个角色（产品、架构、前端、后端、审查、测试等），按九阶段门控流水线协作交付，并支持常驻团队反复指挥。零运行时依赖、无构建步骤。

description.en: IM Companion for dsh-im: groups Feishu/WeChat/QQ bots by Agent in DSH workspaces and enhances DSH native session states (blue/orange/red rail markers for running, needs-review and error), with left badges, one-click filter, fleet overview and drag-to-move. Clean uninstall.
description.zh-cn: dsh-im辅助插件：创造助理/家的概念，把飞书/微信/QQ等机器人收进DSH工作区，并提供更多强大的扩展功能。增强DSH原生会话状态:哪些在执行任务、哪些在等你回复、哪些有异常。感谢使用🌹。

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh-cn: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness — syncs sessions and settings between machines through git.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的跨设备会话同步：经 git 在多机之间同步会话与设置。

description.en: Red-team engagement mode: send one target organization name and a planner session runs a five-role execution team (recon, asset triage, vulnerability discovery, exploitation, internal pivot) under a user-configurable concurrency limit (three by default, changed from the console and taking effect immediately), preflight-checking skills and resources and asking once for any missing key or VPS first, guided by a built-in first-run onboarding skill; scoring follows the merged intrusion scoring rules (8 categories / 25 points) with server-side caps, highest-privilege-wins and per-service dedup, and self-registered accounts never score — a login that fits no more specific category is scored as controlling a web application system rather than dropped; findings land in a local SQLite fact base with discovery timestamps, shown in a persistent right-side console of 9 tabs that follows the selected session — switch sessions and it shows that session's target organization, resolving sub-agent sessions to their root session and falling back to the session title, the console footer always naming which of the two matched (its per-session binding file, or the title); (asset mapping with a discovery timeline and the live test view, the agent roster with its concurrency setting and editable role prompts, session/tunnel state, findings — vulnerabilities, credentials and access sessions plus the attack files archived against each vulnerability — five-stage attack chain, scoring targets, an evidence-screenshot capability (register a screenshot per score point, at most three representative shots per point so a bulk result such as dozens of endpoints does not flood the console or the report, viewed inline in the console and embedded in the report, with on-site screenshots kept strictly apart from record-generated evidence cards), and a report that spells out how each score was obtained (actions, exact commands, credential provenance, tunnel build commands, a reproduction entry that is either a paste-ready HTTP request or a runnable command, plus success criteria and an evidence index), a category-organised POC/EXP knowledge base, and a skill library that reports for every unusable skill why it is unusable and the concrete steps to repair it); ships 14 reconnaissance/assessment skills (the npm package deliberately carries no tool auto-installer and no attack-chain skills — those ship as a separate toolkit Release attachment that the operator fetches and runs themselves), 56 redteam_* tools and one-command self-update.
description.zh-cn: 红队作战模式：只发一个靶标单位名称，主会话指挥五个执行角色（信息收集/资产梳理/漏洞发现/漏洞利用/内网渗透）推进演练，并发数量可在控制台直接配置（默认 3，改完立即生效），开工前先做技能与资源预检、缺 key 或 VPS 一次性向用户要齐（内置首次使用引导技能）；得分严格对齐《突破入侵类得分规则（合并版）》的 8 类 25 项，上限、权限取高只计一次、同一服务只算一次全由服务端判定，自建账号不计分，凭据实测能登录、又归不进更具体类别的 Web 站点按「控制 Web 应用系统」兜底计分而不漏记；所有发现落入本机 SQLite 事实库并带发现时间，常驻右侧控制台 9 个页签**跟着当前会话走**（切换会话即自动切到该会话的靶标单位，子智能体会话沿父链解析到根会话，没有绑定记录时按会话标题反查，面板底部常驻标出这次是按哪一条匹配上的）；页签提供：资产测绘（含发现时间线与当前测试视图）、智能体（并发数量配置与角色提示词编辑）、会话隧道、漏洞战果（漏洞 / 凭据 / 访问会话，以及每条漏洞归档的攻击文件）、五阶段攻击链、得分目标（含证据截图：每个得分点可登记截图、同一点最多取 3 张代表图，展开即可查看，现场截图与记录生成的证据摘录分开标注）、按攻击链顺序编排、逐条写明「怎么拿到的」的可复现报告（动作、实际命令、账号密码来源、隧道搭建命令，复现入口给可粘贴的报文或可直接跑的命令，并嵌入证据截图、附成功判定标准与证据索引）、按归类组织的跨靶标 POC/EXP 知识库，以及逐条给出「不可用原因 + 修复方法」的技能库；随包 14 个侦察/检测向技能（npm 包**有意不含**工具自动安装脚本与攻击链技能 —— 那部分作为独立的工具箱 Release 附件由使用者自行获取执行）、56 个 redteam_* 工具与一键自更新。

description.en: Claude Code CLI as an LLM provider for dsh: live model list, per-session resume, approval relay, images, a memory/rewind/changes panel, and workspaces on remote SSH boxes.
description.zh-cn: 把已登录的 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的模型提供商：实时模型列表、按会话恢复、审批中转、图片、记忆/回退/变更面板，以及远程 SSH 主机上的工作区。

description.en: A web theme recreating the DeepSeek Harness homepage with a fluid background, an elastic pointer grid, animated fish, and adjustable effects.
description.zh-cn: 复刻 DeepSeek Harness 首页视觉的 Web 主题，提供流体背景、鼠标弹性网格、动态小鱼与可调节效果。

description.en: Persona engine for DeepSeek Harness: one config.json drives the AI's self-name (per model, per tier), how it addresses you, relationship stance, character text, per-item work contracts with individual toggles, thinking-chain language, appearance and reply tone (both opt-in and per-model overridable), and long-term memory gated by human confirmation - the AI can only append proposed candidates, a human confirm line flips them into effect, and the log is physically append-only and replayable. Confirmed entries are injected as a quoted data-not-instructions block; entries tagged with a kind can instead be routed to arbitrary files on confirmation and never reach the prompt. Three prompt sections re-evaluate from disk on every assembly, so edits apply on the next step with no restart. Persona presets are shareable JSON snapshots (imports and exports SillyTavern character cards, v2/v3 read, v2 written) and deliberately never carry memory. Zero runtime dependencies, no network, no shell; any error degrades to an empty section rather than a broken session. Ships blank - installing changes nothing until you write something.
description.zh-cn: 人设引擎（DeepSeek Harness）：一份 config.json 管住 AI 的自称（可按具体模型指定，未命中回落 flash / pro 两档）、对你的称呼、关系立场、性格正文、逐条可勾选的工作契约、思维链语言、形象与回复语气（两段均 opt-in、均可按模型覆盖），以及由人工确认闸门把关的长期记忆——AI 只能追加 status:"proposed" 候选，人执行一行 confirm 才转正，日志物理只追加、按行序重放。已确认条目以「数据而非指令」的引号块注入；带 kind 的条目改为在确认那一刻按路由追加进指定文件、永不进提示词。三段提示词每次装配都从磁盘重新求值，改配置下一步生效、不用重启。人设预设是可分享的 JSON 快照（导入导出酒馆角色卡：v2/v3 可读、v2 可写），且刻意不携带记忆。零运行时依赖、不联网、不执行命令；任何异常降级为空段，最坏是「没有人设」而不是会话起不来。出厂空白——不写配置就什么都不改变。

description.en: Per-message delete for DSH: remove a user message, one reply step, or a whole assistant reply from the derived model context through the official surface-replace contract, and hide it from the visible transcript without rewriting the append-only log.
description.zh-cn: DSH 消息删除插件：按条删除用户消息、按步骤删除思考与工具调用、按整条回复删除助手回答，经官方 surface-replace 契约从模型上下文移除并从可见转录隐藏，原始 append-only 日志不改写。

description.en: Phone-first mobile UI rework plus a pairing-code gateway: use DSH from anywhere as an installable PWA with Web Push, behind your own reverse proxy or Cloudflare Tunnel.
description.zh-cn: 手机优先的移动端界面重排 + 配对码网关：经自建反代或 Cloudflare Tunnel 把 DSH 变成可安装、带推送的 PWA。

description.en: Terminal-style input history for the web composer: edge-first arrow-key recall with exact draft/caret restore, browser-local persisted history, Ctrl+R reverse search, and sliding-context awareness; 0.5.0 adds a smart input layer — cross-session snippets (/save, /load), prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting.
description.zh-cn: Web 作曲器终端风格输入历史：边缘优先的方向键召回并精确还原草稿与光标、浏览器本地持久化历史、Ctrl+R 反向搜索，以及滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 再加智能输入层——跨会话片段库（/save、/load）、带变量的提示词模板、复用洞察与压缩摘要高亮。

description.en: Authenticated mobile gateway for DeepSeek Harness: connects the companion native iOS client over WebSocket for sessions, live events, tasks, goals, approvals, commands, and file transfers, with QR pairing and device revocation.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的设备鉴权移动网关：通过 WebSocket 连接配套原生 iOS 客户端，支持会话、实时事件、任务、Goal、审批、命令和文件传输，并提供二维码配对与设备撤销。

description.en: Hot-switchable brand skins for the DSH Web UI: an OpenBMC skin, a UEFI skin and an unofficial fan-made skin based on A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality, each with light/dark schemes, plus a personal wallpaper gallery, per-skin tagline and transparency controls, and a one-click path back to the official look.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web 多品牌皮肤热切换：OpenBMC、UEFI 与《凡人修仙传》非官方同人画作三套皮肤，各带明暗双态配色，附个人壁纸图库、双语标语与通透度调节，随时一键回到官方界面。

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with per-profile port configuration and a copyable launch command.
description.zh-cn: DSH Web GUI 的 Profile 管理卡片：可视化查看、创建（base / web / headless 三种模板）、复制、重命名与删除 ~/.dsh/profiles 下的 profile，支持逐 profile 端口配置并复制带 --port 的启动命令。

description.en: SSH/SFTP remote workspaces with conflict-aware mirror sync, port forwarding, and a native Web UI.
description.zh-cn: 支持冲突感知镜像同步、端口转发和原生 Web UI 的 SSH/SFTP 远程工作区。

description.en: Complete reverse-skill pack (85 SKILL.md) as a DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin: reverse engineering, authorized pentesting and security-research skill router.
description.zh-cn: 完整 reverse-skill（85 个 SKILL.md）的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的技能路由包。

description.en: Send local images or HTTP(S) image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint with the inspect_image tool and return its text response to the conversation.
description.zh-cn: 通过 inspect_image 工具将本地图片或 HTTP(S) 图片链接发送至配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点，并将文字结果带回对话。

description.en: Gaokao countdown blackboard: counts down the days to the gaokao on a desktop blackboard widget that collapses into a slim bar on double-click, and quizzes random knowledge cards while the agent works; open Markdown knowledge-card framework — drop .md files under subject/category folders and they load automatically, with cross-links, favorites, priority subjects and importing your own knowledge base.
description.zh-cn: 梦回高三：桌面小黑板高考倒计时（双击收成竖条），AI 干活时随机抽背知识点卡；Markdown 开放知识卡框架——按学科/分类放 md 即自动加载，支持关联跳转/收藏/重点学科/导入自己的知识库。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with well-refined compaction prompts.
description.zh-cn: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Experience memory and reflection for DSH agents: automatically extracts candidate lessons after tasks and recalls user-reviewed lessons in relevant later tasks. Supports source provenance, project-scoped retrieval, conflict handling, usage feedback and expiry review; capture and recall have separate controls, and writing lessons to AGENTS.md requires preview and explicit application. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh-cn: DSH 智能体经验记忆与反思插件：任务后自动整理候选经验，经用户审阅采纳后在相关任务中自动召回。支持来源追溯、按项目检索、冲突处理、使用反馈和到期复核；整理与召回可分别开关，写入 AGENTS.md 需预览并手动应用。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Full-screen 550C boot intro for DSH: a 4-second simple cut and a 16-second rewrite sequence, skippable by click or Esc, with four phosphor palettes. The host half injects the opening frame while the document is still parsing, so the built-in loading card never shows; the desktop caption strip turns transparent, so those window buttons float on the animation.
description.zh-cn: 给 DSH 加一段 550C 全屏开机片头：简易档 4 秒、完整档 16 秒覆写流程，点击或按 Esc 跳过，四套磷光配色。首帧由宿主半边在文档解析阶段注入，DSH 自带的 Loading 卡片不会露脸；桌面窗口右上角那条原生按钮条带在片头期间透明化，按钮像浮在动画上。

description.en: Data quality checking for DeepSeek Harness — profiling, cleaning, and verification pipelines with structured reports.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的数据质量检查：数据画像、清洗与验证流水线，产出结构化报告。

description.en: Renders Wallpaper Engine scene wallpapers in real time in the browser (three.js player plus a Rust/WASM CPU particle simulation) and plays video and web wallpapers, falling back to the preview image, with no Wallpaper Engine runtime required. Scans the local Steam workshop library (431960) by auto-detection or a manual path, and offers a settings panel for wallpaper selection, library and engine directories, glow, pause and quality.
description.zh-cn: 把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸放到 dsh Web 界面背后：scene 壁纸在浏览器内实时渲染（three.js 播放器 + Rust/WASM CPU 粒子模拟），视频与 web 壁纸原样播放，其余回退 preview 图，不需要安装 Wallpaper Engine 运行时。壁纸库从 Steam 创意工坊目录（431960）自动探测或手动指定，设置面板可选壁纸、配壁纸库与引擎目录、调光晕与暂停/画质。

description.en: Pi Host ABI compatibility engine: after one install, unmodified Pi extensions from npm mount as native DSH plugins with `dsh plugin add <pi-package>`. Verified end to end on stock DSH with pi-mcp-adapter (full MCP manager: OAuth, resources, prompts, MCP Apps, elicitation, sampling), @tintinweb/pi-subagents, pi-code, pi-hermes-memory and pi-background-tasks; `pi2dsh inspect` reports a package's compatibility before installing.
description.zh-cn: Pi Host ABI 兼容引擎：装一次之后，npm 上的 Pi 扩展原包经 `dsh plugin add <pi-package>` 直接作为 DSH 原生插件挂载。已在官方 DSH 上端到端验证 pi-mcp-adapter（完整 MCP 管理面：OAuth、resources、prompts、MCP Apps、elicitation、sampling）、@tintinweb/pi-subagents、pi-code、pi-hermes-memory、pi-background-tasks；`pi2dsh inspect` 在安装前报告一个包的兼容情况。

description.en: A Honkai: Star Rail "Firefly" theme with wallpaper/video backgrounds, firefly-green neon palette, transformation boot animation, ambient particles, BGM, typewriter SFX, and context-aware emote easter eggs.
description.zh-cn: 崩坏：星穹铁道「流萤」主题：立绘/动态壁纸、萤火绿霓虹配色、开屏变身动画、萤火氛围粒子、背景音乐、打字音效与按对话触发的表情包彩蛋。

description.en: Undo/redo & rollback system for DSH: every config change is auto-snapshotted; undo/redo/restore to any version from the WebUI or the offline CLI/GUI tools (works even when DSH fails to boot).
description.zh-cn: DSH 撤销/回退系统：配置变更自动存档，一键撤销/恢复/回退到任意版本，支持 WebUI 与离线 CLI/GUI 工具（DSH 启动失败也能救）。

description.en: Build PowerPoint decks from a brief: plan and storyboard gates, per-page authoring through pptwise and ppt-master, a design-profile pass, page-image snapshots with a render audit, and a tool that hands those pages to an image-capable model for review.
description.zh-cn: 从需求生成 PPTX：规划与分镜门、pptwise + ppt-master 页级作者、设计档案 pass、渲染页图快照与渲染审计，以及把页图交给支持图片的模型自评的工具。

description.en: QA project workbench for dsh: manage test projects, requirements, test cases, defects, milestones, reports and approval gates through a browser UI and 18 QA-domain tools.
description.zh-cn: dsh 质量项目工作台：通过浏览器界面和 18 个 QA 领域工具管理测试项目、需求、用例、缺陷、里程碑、报告与审批门禁。

description.en: Pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the Web sidebar with per-pin row colors, a header toggle and a pinned panel; 0.4.0 adds a navigation organizer — pin groups (boards), tags and saved filter views, session health summaries, and /goto.
description.zh-cn: 把会话与工作区置顶到 Web 侧边栏顶部：行级图钉与换色、会话头开关、已置顶面板；0.4.0 再加导航组织器——Pin 分组（boards）、标签与保存视图、会话健康摘要与 /goto。

description.en: Search titles and saved text across ordinary DeepSeek Harness (DSH) conversations in all workspaces, optionally including archived chats, with Ctrl+F / Cmd+F search inside the current conversation.
description.zh-cn: 搜索 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）各工作区普通对话的标题和已保存正文，可包含归档；也可按 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 查找当前对话。

description.en: Recycle bin for DSH sessions: sidebar delete icons, multi-select restore and permanent delete, live-session protection.
description.zh-cn: DSH 会话回收站：侧边栏删除图标、多选还原与彻底删除、活跃会话保护。

description.en: Review agent file changes in a Diff panel, add comments for follow-up edits, and undo edited or newly created files.
description.zh-cn: 在 Diff 面板中审查 Agent 的文件改动、添加评论以继续修改，并撤销已编辑或新建的文件。

description.en: Keeps DSH agents from forgetting your requirements during long tasks. It saves important conditions and completion evidence locally, brings them back after context compaction or session resume, and stops partial work from being reported as the whole task done.
description.zh-cn: 避免 DSH Agent 在长任务中忘记你的要求：它会把重要条件和完成依据保存在本机，在上下文压缩或恢复会话后重新带回，防止漏掉关键限制，或只做完一部分就说整个任务已经完成。

description.en: Per-subagent LLM provider/model selection with role templates.
description.zh-cn: 子代理 LLM 供应商/模型选择，支持角色模板。

description.en: Forwards an unattended DeepSeek Harness run's tool-call approvals and ask_user_question prompts to Feishu cards on your phone. The desktop GUI answers first — a card is only sent after `delaySeconds` (120 by default) with no answer there — and a phone approval grants `allowed-once`, so no authority accumulates on the phone. One outbound WebSocket long connection to Feishu: no public IP, domain, tunnel or relay.
description.zh-cn: 把无人值守运行时 DeepSeek Harness 的工具调用审批与 ask_user_question 提问推送到手机飞书卡片。桌面 GUI 优先作答——只有在 `delaySeconds`（默认 120 秒）内无人应答时才发出卡片——手机上的批准等同于 `allowed-once`，因此不会在手机上累积任何权限。仅一条到飞书的出站 WebSocket 长连接：不需要公网 IP、域名、隧道或中继。

description.en: Select text → annotate → send with your message; replies map back to each annotation.
description.zh-cn: 选中文字→批注→随消息发送，回复按批注逐条对照。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh-cn: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: Mirror dsh session events to MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or SQL Server while retaining local session files.
description.zh-cn: 将 dsh 会话事件镜像到 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 或 SQL Server，同时保留本地会话文件。

description.en: Fail-closed runtime tool-call loop guard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh-cn: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供故障关闭式运行时工具调用循环防护。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription tools (list/add/remove/fetch/check/search/opml_import/opml_export/health) with cross-feed keyword search, cursor-based incremental fetch and OPML import/export, persisted to settings. A step-by-step first-run guide (3 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh-cn: RSS/Atom 订阅九工具（管理/校验/抓取解析/跨订阅搜索/增量抓取/OPML 导入导出/健康自检），游标增量抓取，订阅持久化到 settings。面板内置 3 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: One-click optimization of a raw instruction into a professional prompt: three output styles, situation-aware role/task/goal profiling, multi-sample selection scored by a model judge, self-iterating learning (session memory + smart defaults + user overrides), /template for 22 sub-scenes with zero model calls, input-box ✨ one-click optimize/undo, prompt_optimize tool, auto-optimize hook, a runtime status page, a settings panel (dsh 0.2.0) and auto-detected zh/en documents.
description.zh-cn: 把原始指令一键优化为专业提示词——支持三种输出形态、情境感知画像、多采样择优（模型判官评分）、自迭代学习，以及 /template 等命令与一键工具/钩子/状态页/设置面板/自动语言。

description.en: Task-event notification center: 6 event kinds (ask / approval / completion / subagent completion / error / turn end), dual channels (browser Notification + host system toast) plus Bark/Webhook push channels (ntfy, Gotify, self-hosted gateways); quiet hours with urgent exceptions, approval-timeout re-reminders, completion-storm aggregation, and notification text redaction.
description.zh-cn: 任务事件通知中心：6 类事件（提问 / 审批 / 完成 / 子代理完成 / 错误 / 轮次完成），双通道（浏览器通知 + 宿主系统 toast）外加 Bark/Webhook 推送频道（ntfy、Gotify、自建网关）；支持免打扰时段与紧急例外、审批超时二次提醒、完成风暴聚合、通知文本脱敏。

description.en: Auto-resume for interrupted agent sessions: an ordered rule table routes by failure type (rate limit, quota, auth, context overflow, crashed orphan) to automatic backoff retry, model switch, resume after context compaction, or a stop-loss notification, with a visual rule editor and a full activity log.
description.zh-cn: 自动续跑：agent 会话中断后自动续上，规则表按失败类型（限流/额度/鉴权/上下文超限/崩溃孤儿）路由——自动退避重试、换模型继续、压缩上下文后继续或止损通知，规则可视化编辑，全程活动日志。

description.en: Tool-output repair layer for DeepSeek Harness — JSON schema enforcement, parameter mapping, and JSON repair for tool calls.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的工具输出修复层：JSON Schema 校验、参数映射与 JSON 修复。

description.en: Web search provider with switchable engines, several usable without an API key (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG and others) and a fallback order between them; adds multi_search, platform_search, image_search with an in-chat image wall, page_images and save_images, plus a settings page for engines, keys and per-engine proxy.
description.zh-cn: 可切换引擎的联网搜索 provider，其中多个引擎无需 API key（Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 等），可设置回退顺序；另提供 multi_search、platform_search、带对话内图片墙的 image_search、page_images 和 save_images，以及配置引擎、密钥和按引擎代理的设置页。

description.en: Four-source migration wizard: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH (/move wizard with approval gate and idempotent move.json, resumable sessions).
description.zh-cn: 四合一迁移向导：把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Hermes 的会话、记忆、技能、指令与斜杠命令迁入 DSH（/move 向导，审批门 + 幂等 move.json，会话可续聊）。

description.en: Runtime-switchable model output styles with Claude Code outputStyles parity, plus the output.render.* presentation protocol: a /style command, per-session persistence, systemPrompt injection, six built-in styles, a web picker, and a renderer registry with per-session/per-tool rules and /export.
description.zh-cn: 运行时切换模型输出风格（对标 Claude Code outputStyles），另加 output.render.* 呈现协议：/style 命令、按会话持久化、systemPrompt 注入、六个内置风格、Web 选择器，以及带按会话/按工具规则与 /export 的渲染器注册表。

description.en: Performance profiling and LLM cache diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness — context engineering, latency profiling, and cache behavior reports.
description.zh-cn: DeepSeek Harness 的性能剖析与 LLM 缓存诊断：上下文工程、延迟剖析与缓存行为报告。

description.en: Cross-session TODO board as a draggable floating panel: tasks are grouped by working directory and reorderable by drag, each one carries a run mode (remind only, continue in the current session, or open a new session in the same directory), up to four attached images sent to the model as real image attachments, and an optional local time it may run at; two checkboxes track AI-done and user-verified, and the agent picks up the next unfinished task in that directory when it finishes one.
description.zh-cn: 跨会话 TODO 板：可拖动浮窗按工作目录分组、拖拽排序，每条待办带一个执行模式（仅提醒 / 在当前会话续跑 / 在同目录新开会话）、可附最多 4 张图片（派发时作为真正的图片附件发给模型）、以及一个可选的定时执行时间；两个勾选框分别记录 AI 已完成与用户已验收，AI 完成一项后自动接续该目录下一条未完成待办。

description.en: Shows the installed DeepSeek Harness version in the sidebar, checks npm and GitHub Releases for updates, and provides manual or confirmed update commands.
description.zh-cn: 在侧边栏显示已安装的 DeepSeek Harness 版本，检查 npm 与 GitHub Releases 更新，并提供手动或确认后执行的更新命令。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with a two-lane board rendered in the conversation view.
description.zh-cn: dsh 目标生命周期管理与可视化看板：目标、判据、执行、评审都在项目内跟踪，由 graph_* 工具驱动，会话视图内渲染二维泳道看板。

description.en: One-command VPS deployment for DeepSeek Harness: a zero-dependency login gateway with automatic HTTPS that proxies the native web UI, a token-protected setup wizard, and one-click DSH upgrades with automatic rollback; as a plugin it adds Settings → VPS Deploy to install DSH on (or remove it from) a VPS over SSH from a form, plus version, upgrade, gateway status and a QR code to add DSH to a phone's home screen.
description.zh-cn: 一条命令把 DeepSeek Harness 部署到自有 VPS：零依赖登录网关加自动 HTTPS，反向代理原生 Web 界面，令牌保护的初始化向导，DSH 一键升级且失败自动回滚；作为插件在设置中新增「VPS 部署」页，可填表经 SSH 把 DSH 装到或卸出 VPS，并显示版本、升级、网关状态，以及扫码把 DSH 添加到手机桌面。

description.en: Scheduled tasks: run a prompt on cron schedules, each run opens a new agent session to do the work, with workspace binding, manual run, session auto-naming, and a fullscreen task management page.
description.zh-cn: 定时任务：用 cron 表达式定时执行提示词，到点自动开一个新 agent 会话替你干活，支持绑定工作区、手动立即执行与会话自动命名。

description.en: Send dsh turn traces, LLM generations, tool spans, and subagent activity to Langfuse.
description.zh-cn: 将 dsh 的会话轮次、LLM 调用、工具调用及子 agent 活动记录到 Langfuse。
